headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRootPhysical.adjacent_physical_box_leaf_transport_retained
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J]
  (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) (L : ℕ) (s : I × J) (hs : small s.1 s.2 = true)
  (σ : I × J → ℕ) (U l : ℕ),
  2 ≤ U →
    1 ≤ l →
      l ≤ U →
        (∀ (i : I) (j : J), small i j = false → 2 ≤ B i j) →
          (∀ (a : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Earlier small s), σ ↑↑a ≤ U) →
            ∀ {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Later small s)
              (H : OAI.ContingencyTables.PhysicalCompletionFibres.SmallProfile small → ℝ),
              0 <
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperContextTransport.contextHard small B r c L
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U))
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U (l - 1)) →
                0 <
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperContextTransport.contextHard small B r c L
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U))
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U l) →
                  let Ms := OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U;
                  have f :=
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperContextTransport.contextHard small B r c L Ms
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U);
                  have a :=
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U (l - 1));
                  have b :=
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U l);
                  have g :=
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerBoxTruncation.truncate f
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.bounds (fun x => U) Ms) (U + Ms.sum);
                  have A :=
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.FactorialSignatures.integerRemovalMatrix
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.correctionKernel Ms g)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.rootDisplay U l);
                  have h := fun p => H (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.assemble small s hs σ U e p);
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms (fun p => f p * h p)
                            (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U (l - 1)) /
                          a -
                        OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms (fun p => f p * h p)
                            (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U l) /
                          b) ^
                      2 ≤
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.retainedRootCoefficient A a b *
                      Math115.PhysicalLeafEnergy.physicalLeafEnergy small s hs σ U l e
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperPhysicalMarginal.hardMarginal small B r c L) H

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRootPhysical.retainedRootCoefficient_shift
headlines.statement:
∀ (F : (Bool → ℕ) → ℝ) (U l : ℕ) (s t : ℝ),
  1 ≤ l →
    l ≤ U →
      OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.retainedRootCoefficient
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FactorialSignatures.integerRemovalMatrix F
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.rootDisplay U l))
          s t =
        1 / s + 1 / t -
              (if 2 ≤ l then F (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.auxRoot U (l - 1)) else 0) / s ^ 2 +
            2 * F (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.auxRoot U l) / (s * t) -
          (if l < U then F (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.auxRoot U (l + 1)) else 0) / t ^ 2

headlines.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.retainedRootCoefficient_nonnegative_limit
headlines.statement:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {l : Filter K} [l.NeBot] (Ms : List ℕ)
  (F : K → (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.Coordinates Bool Ms → ℕ) → ℝ)
  (f : (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.Coordinates Bool Ms → ℕ) → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.Coordinates Bool Ms → ℕ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun t => F t x) l (nhds (f x))) →
    ∀ (m z : Bool → ℕ) (R : ℕ),
      (∀ U ∈ Ms, 2 ≤ U) →
        (∀ᶠ (t : K) in l,
            (∀ (x : OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.Coordinates Bool Ms → ℕ), 0 ≤ F t x) ∧
              OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedBox.PositiveSlice (F t) (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.bounds m Ms)
                  (R + Ms.sum) ∧
                OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedBox.RemovalSlice (F t) (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.bounds m Ms)
                  (R + Ms.sum)) →
          OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedBox.InBox m z →
            ∑ i, z i = R + 1 →
              0 <
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.oneHole
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f) z false →
                0 <
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.oneHole
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f) z true →
                  0 ≤
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.retainedRootCoefficient
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FactorialSignatures.integerRemovalMatrix
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.correctionKernel Ms f) z)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.oneHole
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f) z false)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.oneHole
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f) z true)

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedPhysicalCap.physical_correction_le_adjacent
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J]
  (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) (L : ℕ) (s : I × J) (hs : small s.1 s.2 = true)
  (σ : I × J → ℕ) (U l : ℕ),
  1 ≤ l →
    l ≤ U →
      (∀ (i : I) (j : J), small i j = true → B i j = U) →
        (∀ (a : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Earlier small s), σ ↑↑a ≤ U) →
          ∀ {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Later small s),
            (∀
                (T :
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualTables small r c
                    (fun i => r i + OAI.ContingencyTables.PaddedCompletions.rowLargeCount small i * L) fun j =>
                    c j + OAI.ContingencyTables.PaddedCompletions.columnLargeCount small j * L)
                (i : I) (j : J), ↑↑T i j ≤ B i j) →
              let Ms := OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U;
              have f :=
                OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperContextTransport.contextHard small B r c L Ms
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U);
              have g :=
                OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerBoxTruncation.truncate f
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.bounds (fun x => U) Ms) (U + Ms.sum);
              OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.correctionKernel Ms g
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.auxRoot U l) ≤
                ↑n * ↑(Math115.RetainedRoot.quarterProduct U) *
                  max
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U (l - 1)))
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U l))

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedPhysicalSupport.positive_physical_support_diameter
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J]
  (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) (L : ℕ) (s : I × J) (hs : small s.1 s.2 = true)
  (σ : I × J → ℕ) (U : ℕ),
  (∀ (i : I) (j : J), small i j = true → B i j = U) →
    (∀ (a : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Earlier small s), σ ↑↑a ≤ U) →
      ∀ (β : Fin (U + 1)) (α : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Later small s),
        (∀
            (T :
              OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualTables small r c
                (fun i => r i + OAI.ContingencyTables.PaddedCompletions.rowLargeCount small i * L) fun j =>
                c j + OAI.ContingencyTables.PaddedCompletions.columnLargeCount small j * L)
            (i : I) (j : J), ↑↑T i j ≤ B i j) →
          0 <
              OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperContextTransport.contextHard small B r c L
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U))
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U ↑β) →
            ↑β - α ≤ Math115.RetainedPhysicalSupport.effectiveWidth small r c - 1

headlines.name: Research.PositiveSupport.positive_support_restriction
headlines.statement:
∀ (z h : ℕ → ℝ) (U : ℕ),
  (∀ i ≤ U, 0 ≤ z i) →
    Research.PositiveSupport.NoValley z U →
      (∃ i ≤ U, 0 < z i) →
        ∃ α β m,
          Research.PositiveSupport.SupportInterval z U α β ∧
            m ≤ β - α ∧
              (∀ k ≤ β - α, 0 < z (α + k)) ∧
                (∀ (i j : ℕ), i ≤ j → j ≤ m → z (α + i) ≤ z (α + j)) ∧
                  (∀ (i j : ℕ), m ≤ i → i ≤ j → j ≤ β - α → z (α + j) ≤ z (α + i)) ∧
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance (fun i => z ↑i) fun i => h ↑i) =
                      OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance (fun k => z (α + ↑k)) fun k => h (α + ↑k)

headlines.name: Research.SpectralPath.exists_path_rayleigh_minimizer
headlines.statement:
∀ (N : ℕ),
  1 ≤ N →
    ∀ (z : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin (N + 1)), 0 < z i) →
        (∀ (l : Fin N), 0 < r (↑l + 1)) →
          ∃ lam h,
            0 < lam ∧
              (Research.SpectralPath.weightedSum z) h = 0 ∧
                h ≠ 0 ∧
                  0 < OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance z h ∧
                    lam =
                        Research.SpectralPath.pathEnergy N r h /
                          OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance z h ∧
                      (∀ (g : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ),
                          (Research.SpectralPath.weightedSum z) g = 0 →
                            g ≠ 0 →
                              lam ≤
                                Research.SpectralPath.pathEnergy N r g /
                                  OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance z g) ∧
                        (∀ (l : Fin N),
                            h l.castSucc - h l.succ = lam * r (↑l + 1) * Research.SpectralPath.prefixFlux N z h l) ∧
                          OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance z h =
                              lam * ∑ l, r (↑l + 1) * Research.SpectralPath.prefixFlux N z h l ^ 2 ∧
                            ∀ (g : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ),
                              OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance z g ≤
                                1 / lam * Research.SpectralPath.pathEnergy N r g

headlines.name: Research.SpectralRetained.retained_spectral_variance_bound
headlines.statement:
∀ (z h c E : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (N m : ℕ),
  1 ≤ N →
    m ≤ N →
      0 ≤ K →
        (∀ i ≤ N, 0 < z i) →
          (∀ (i j : ℕ), i ≤ j → j ≤ m → z i ≤ z j) →
            (∀ (i j : ℕ), m ≤ i → i ≤ j → j ≤ N → z j ≤ z i) →
              (∀ i ≤ N + 1, 0 ≤ c i) →
                (∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ N → c j ≤ K * max (z (j - 1)) (z j)) →
                  (∀ l ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, 0 ≤ Research.RetainedStencilSum.stencil z c l) →
                    (∀ l ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, 0 ≤ E l) →
                      (∀ l ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (h l - h (l - 1)) ^ 2 ≤ Research.RetainedStencilSum.stencil z c l * E l) →
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.FiniteExposureVariance.variance (fun i => z ↑i) fun i => h ↑i) ≤
                          (↑N * (↑N + 1) + 2 * K) * ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, E l

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRootSquare.tight_fullCoefficient_bound
headlines.statement: ∀ (p V : ℕ), 2 ≤ p → 2 ≤ V → Math115.RetainedRootSquare.tightFullCoefficient p V ≤ 2 * ↑p ^ 3 * ↑V ^ 2

headlines.name: Research.GrowthRefinement.doubled_growth_twice
headlines.statement:
∀ (enlarged original q H s : ℕ),
  0 < H →
    enlarged * (2 * H) ^ (2 * q) ≤ original * (2 * H + s) ^ (2 * q) → 47 * q * s ≤ 32 * H → enlarged ≤ 2 * original

headlines.name: Math115.LegacyResidualCap.all_state_l7_cap
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (U : ℕ) (B : I → J → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : I) (j : J),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U i j = false →
        ∑ k, r k + 7 * (Math115.LegacyResidualCap.largeRowCount r U * Math115.LegacyResidualCap.largeColumnCount c U) ≤
          B i j) →
    ∀
      (z :
        OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.PhysicalStates
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c 7)
      (i : I) (j : J),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U i j = false →
        ∑ k,
            OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.residualRows
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c 7 z k ≤
          B i j
